description: This file defines defaulting functions and constants for Kubernetes HorizontalPodAutoscaler v2, including scaling policies, rules, and behavior defaults.

methods.name: addDefaultingFuncs
methods.description: Registers defaulting functions for the runtime scheme.

methods.name: SetDefaults_HorizontalPodAutoscaler
methods.description: Sets default values for HorizontalPodAutoscaler object, including min replicas and metrics.

methods.name: SetDefaults_HorizontalPodAutoscalerBehavior
methods.description: Fills in behavior rules for scale-up and scale-down if they are present.

methods.name: GenerateHPAScaleUpRules
methods.description: Returns a fully-initialized HPAScalingRules for scale-up, copying defaults where necessary.

methods.name: GenerateHPAScaleDownRules
methods.description: Returns a fully-initialized HPAScalingRules for scale-down, copying defaults where necessary.

methods.name: copyHPAScalingRules
methods.description: Copies non-nil fields from one HPAScalingRules to another.
